description: Who provides the tool's implementation, ordered by what the customer must add. `semantius` = Semantius covers it out of the box; flip a tool to `semantius` only when the capability ships on BOTH the `crud` MCP server AND the `semantius` CLI. `agent_native` = the agent itself: its model (generation, classification, extraction, translation, vision, matching, reasoning over records) or a host built-in (web search and fetch, code sandbox). `agent_common` = the agent through the customer's Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 (mail, calendar, chat, files, intranet). `agent_first` = an agent-ready outside service (an MCP server or a self-serve API) the agent uses with a subscription and no integration work (e-signature, payments, telephony, transcription, ad and social platforms). `vendor_platform` = the engine of a vendor's own platform (proprietary scoring, forecasting, inference, runtime, endpoint agent), not sold as a standalone service, so it must be built or approximated. `external` = needs integration work: certified or contracted access (tax and regulatory filings, EDI, MLS, GDS), devices, or always-on inbound channels. semantius_score covers `semantius`; semantius_agent_core adds `agent_native` + `agent_common`; semantius_agent_first adds `agent_first`. Score derivations read this column, not `operation_kind`.
